# Vibtune

> Vibtune is a luxury music streaming app with smart, mood-aware mixes, playlists, and cross-device sync powered by Spotify and YouTube.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing entry that routes visitors into Vibtune.
- [Log in](/login): Sign in to your Vibtune account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a free Vibtune account.
- [Forgot password](/forgot-password): Request a secure password reset link.
